findings.title: Isolated baseline-before-patch ordering is inferred from timestamps, not an explicit artifact
findings.evidence: The GREEN evidence has no standalone status artifact for applying the candidate patch in the isolated checkout. Its baseline-before-candidate order is supported by timestamps and by the exact candidate/baseline title-status-error comparison. The classification remains sound: all 18 failures are the accepted-anchor `truncated canonical value` Phase-3g fixture debt, outside the two changed production seams.

findings.title: Hold refusal precedes the closed-session check in rehearsal/activation but follows it in issue
findings.evidence: performMigrationRehearsal and performMigrationActivation order terminal failure, hold refusal, then closed-session refusal, whereas issue checks closed state before its post-rebase hold refusal. A held session closed by its owner therefore reports the manual-review error for migration calls but the closed-session error for issue. Both are fail closed and effect free; this is precedence consistency, not a liveness or safety defect.
